hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-louisa-state-park/experiences-amenities ('Lake Louisa has 60 full-facility campsites', 'Each site has 30- and 50-amp hookups') + Reserve Florida unit details (all 54 bookable units Electric Hookup 50; Water Hookup on 52; Sewer Hookup Yes on 11 units in loops B and C), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 60 sites in three loops between Dixie and Hammond lakes; the park page says 'Some sites can accommodate rigs up to 50 feet', while Reserve Florida's per-site limits run 35 to 85 ft. 15 of the 54 bookable units are pull-through; 11 have sewer. Primitive equestrian, backpacking and youth sites are separate and booked by phone.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-louisa-state-park/experiences-amenities ('60 full-facility campsites nestled between Dixie and Hammond lakes', 'Some sites can accommodate rigs up to 50 feet') + Reserve Florida search/details for facilities 102-104 (VehicleLength, PullInTypeName), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-louisa-state-park/experiences-amenities ('A dump station is located between Dixie Loop and Sandhill Loop. Campground amenities include two accessible bathhouses'), read 2026-10-21

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-louisa-state-park/experiences-amenities ('Reservations can be made up to 11 months in advance. For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: 60 full-facility sites with 30/50-amp, water at the site, sewer at 11 bookable units, pull-throughs, RVs to 50 ft (park page; the catalog lists longer), dump station, reservable 11 months ahead. Fees left (human-checked 2026-10-12; units still $24 + utility). Showers not named (only 'bathhouses'); fcfs, season and stay limits not stated. Note unchanged (AWH's lake-view observation).
